responsibility: This header defines GCC’s lightweight in-memory XML node model. It declares the abstract `xml::node` base class plus concrete tree types for text nodes, nodes with children, whole documents, elements with ordered attributes and whitespace-preservation flags, comments, raw XML fragments, and abstract doctype declarations, together with the virtual `write_as_xml` interface and helper queries such as `dyn_cast_text` and `find_child_element`. It is the core data-structure API for representing XML trees before they are serialized or incrementally built.
same_name_distinction: Declares the XML node class hierarchy and stored tree structure (`node`, `text`, `document`, `element`, `comment`, `raw`, and `doctypedecl`) used by this module. Unlike `xml.cc`, it provides the in-memory type and API definitions, not the serialization logic, printer behavior, or selftests.
